automatic_recovery_followup.confirmed_defect: A completed request returning the original DHCP lease was treated only as passive address_pending; no further request could occur without manual action.
automatic_recovery_followup.fix: When identity, DHCP mode, connected state, exact original IPv4 addresses, original DHCP server and gateway are all proven, reacquire once under the original deadline; verify target subnet. Do not replay failed/timed-out requests.
automatic_recovery_followup.limits: No arbitrary delay, no deadline extension, maximum two system calls. Unknown DHCP server metadata cannot trigger correction. Linux currently omits DHCP server metadata and retains observation/manual fallback.
automatic_recovery_followup.validation: 70 targeted tests passed, including exact old lease -> second request -> target subnet, repeated stale lease stop, cancellation, insufficient budget and failed request no replay.
automatic_recovery_followup.boundary: An early apply acknowledgment and network-service transition race are plausible; router timing and virtual DHCP origin remain unconfirmed. The corrective request can also return an old lease; live retest required.
